etymologies.etymologyHTML: From elder +‎ -ly.

definitions.definition: old; having lived for relatively many years.
Of an object, being old-fashioned or frail due to aging.

quote.citation: 1988, Anne Tyler, chapter 1, in Breathing Lessons:
quote.text: The car was parked toward the rear of the shop, an elderly gray-blue Dodge. It looked better than it had in years.

definitions.definition: (with definite article, collective) Older people as a whole.
